serverInfo.name: cxt-software-mcp
serverInfo.title: CXT Software (X Dispatch) MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for CXT Software (X Dispatch), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Track shipment ABC123 and tell me when it was picked up and delivered."; "Show all orders for postal code 10001 between October 1 and October 7."; "Validate drivers 101, 102 and 103 for planning and tell me who is unavailable.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CXT Software (X Dispatch) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cxt_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cxt_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cxt_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cxt_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cxt_track_shipments
tools.title: Track shipments
tools.description: Track orders and route stops by tracking number: matches a parcel reference, a parcel item barcode, or Reference1/Reference2 of an order or route stop. Returns shipment summaries with status events and proof of delivery as far as the caller's permissions allow: an INET login sees the most detail; with an Operations App login this endpoint is called without credentials (CXT lists only internet users and anonymous callers for it), which returns the limited public tracking view. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. POST /v2/Shipments/Summaries.

begin_date.description: A date (2026-10-01) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z.

end_date.description: A date (2026-10-01) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z.

page_num.description: CXT's pageNum, documented as 'the offset for the records to return' (default 0). When has_more is true, ask for the next records and check the new page does not repeat the previous one (if it does, pageNum counts records: use a multiple of page_size).

tools.name: cxt_search_shipments
tools.title: Search orders and route stops
tools.description: Search orders and route stops by place, address, city, state, postal code, order template, or only by date range. tracking_type says which field search_criteria is matched against: Location (origin/destination or stop name), Address, City, State, Postal (zip or zip+4), Template (order template name), Tracking (references/barcodes) or DateOnly (no criteria: everything between begin_date and end_date). Returns shipment summaries, up to 1000 per page. An INET login sees the most detail; with an Operations App login this endpoint is called without credentials (CXT lists only internet users and anonymous callers for it), so the view is limited. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. POST /v2/Shipments/Summaries.

begin_date.description: A date (2026-10-01) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z.

end_date.description: A date (2026-10-01) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z.

page_num.description: CXT's pageNum, documented as 'the offset for the records to return' (default 0). When has_more is true, ask for the next records and check the new page does not repeat the previous one (if it does, pageNum counts records: use a multiple of page_size).

tools.name: cxt_list_recent_orders
tools.title: List recent orders
tools.description: The most recent orders of the signed-in INTERNET user (user type INET; the orders of their account). Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. POST /v2/Shipments/Summaries with numRecentOrders.

tools.name: cxt_get_order
tools.title: Get order (internet user)
tools.description: One on-demand order with its status, confirmation, pickup, delivery and proof-of-delivery details, as an INTERNET user sees it (sign in with user type INET). Optionally with the itemized charges. Operations App users should use cxt_get_dispatch_order. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. GET /v2/Orders/{orderId}/{includeItemizedCharges}.

tools.name: cxt_get_dispatch_order
tools.title: Get order (Operations App user)
tools.description: One on-demand order with itemized charges, as an OPERATIONS APP (X Dispatch) user sees it (sign in with user type XDISPATCH): addresses, times, driver, status events, proof of delivery. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. GET /v2/Dispatch/Orders/{onDemandOrderId}.

tools.name: cxt_get_planning_limits
tools.title: Get itinerary planning limits
tools.description: The itinerary planning limits of this X Dispatch system: maxAllowedStops (shipments x 2), maxAllowedLocations and maxAllowedPlaceholders. Needs an Operations App user with the ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS permission. GET /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Settings.

tools.name: cxt_validate_drivers
tools.title: Validate drivers for planning
tools.description: Check whether drivers are available to be planned: for each driver id, vehicle violations (for example an expired inspection) and HR violations (for example not scheduled), each with isBypassable. Changes nothing. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Drivers/Validate.

tools.name: cxt_validate_driver_for_orders
tools.title: Validate a driver for orders
tools.description: Check one driver against specific orders: vehicle violations, HR violations and capability violations (for example Hazmat or Lift Gate that the driver lacks). Changes nothing. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Drivers/{driverId}/Validate.

order_ids.description: Order ids to check the driver against.

tools.name: cxt_plan_orders
tools.title: Plan orders onto drivers
tools.description: Generate a proposed itinerary that assigns on-demand orders to drivers (pickup and delivery stops in sequence, with times, distance and unassigned stops). This only PROPOSES a plan: nothing is dispatched until cxt_save_order_plan is called. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. Check the limits with cxt_get_planning_limits first. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders.

start_time.description: Planning window start, local time, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00.

end_time.description: Planning window end, local time, e.g. 2026-10-01T18:00:00.

tools.name: cxt_optimize_order_plan
tools.title: Re-optimize one driver's order plan
tools.description: Re-optimize a single driver's plan after manual changes (proposal only: nothing is dispatched until cxt_save_order_plan). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Optimize.

driver_id.description: Driver id (or the placeholder's id when is_placeholder).

plan_order_ids.description: Orders currently in this driver's plan.

all_input_order_ids.description: All orders in the planning run.

tools.name: cxt_plan_routes
tools.title: Plan route stops
tools.description: Generate a proposed re-sequencing of the stops of existing routes for one route date (stops move between the output routes, with times, distance and unassigned stops). Proposal only: nothing changes until cxt_save_route_plan is called. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Routes/{postDate}.

input_route_ids.description: Route ids to take stops from.

output_route_ids.description: Route ids to assign stops to.

excluded_stop_ids.description: Stop ids to leave out of planning.

tools.name: cxt_optimize_route_plan
tools.title: Re-optimize one route
tools.description: Re-optimize a single route after manual changes (proposal only: nothing changes until cxt_save_route_plan). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Routes/{postDate}/Optimize.

plan_stop_ids.description: Stops currently assigned to this route.

tools.name: cxt_save_order_plan
tools.title: Save order plan (dispatch orders to drivers)
tools.description: COMMIT an order plan: assigns the orders to the drivers and DISPATCHES them (drivers receive the work in the driver app; customers may be notified by the system's own status rules). Use only after the user has seen and approved the plan from cxt_plan_orders / cxt_optimize_order_plan. Pass each driver's stops from the plan reply: id, type (PICKUP or DELIVERY), sequence and from (the scheduled time). Response is empty on success (204). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Save.

from.description: Scheduled arrival: copy `from` from the plan reply, or {timeStamp: '2026-10-01T08:30:00'}.

isNew.description: Whether this is a new assignment.

driver_pay_locked_status.description: What to do with already locked driver pay: KEEP_LOCKED_AND_DISPATCH or UNLOCK_AND_DISPATCH.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved this plan and wants it dispatched to the drivers now.

annotations.title: Save order plan (dispatch orders to drivers)

tools.name: cxt_save_route_plan
tools.title: Save route plan (reassign route stops)
tools.description: COMMIT a route plan for one route date: moves and re-sequences route stops as in the plan and DISPATCHES the changed routes to drivers. Use only after the user has seen and approved the plan from cxt_plan_routes / cxt_optimize_route_plan. Pass each route's stops from the plan reply: id, sequence and from (the scheduled time). Response is empty on success (204). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Routes/{postDate}/Save.

from.description: Scheduled arrival: copy `from` from the plan reply, or {timeStamp: '2026-10-01T08:30:00'}.

driver_pay_locked_status.description: What to do with already locked driver pay: KEEP_LOCKED_AND_DISPATCH or UNLOCK_AND_DISPATCH.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved this plan and wants it dispatched to the drivers now.
